thread:
dave: Quick heads-up: onboarded Cedar-v1 q4 on staging and ran the multilingual smoke suite. Seeing token splits in Japanese ruby (furigana) and parenthesis flipping when Arabic spans are embedded. BLEU down on ja-zh.

mei: can you paste a short example?

dave: fp32:
> 彼は(太郎)さんと一緒に来た。
q4:
> 彼は( 太郎 ) さん と 一緒 に 来た 。

haruto: spaces inserted between kana and punctuation got separated. Parentheses around AR text also end up mirrored after detok.

mei: did the tokenizer change?

dave: tokenizer v2.1 pinned. The q4 runtime has an experimental post-merge detok pass enabled by default that we added to avoid over-merged tokens. Suspect it splits grapheme clusters because it iterates bytes.

eval-bot: quick run: ja-zh BLEU fp32=26.0, q8=25.6, q4=22.4. Grapheme continuity dropped 0.97->0.89. Diffs at /ci/artifacts/2987654321/diffs.txt

haruto: if q8 is close to fp32 probably q4-specific kernel or heuristic. Can you repro with the flag off?

dave: re-ran q4 with --enable-postmerge=false -> BLEU 25.8, continuity 0.96. So heuristic is the culprit.

mei: mitigation: disable post-merge for q4 in staging recipe. Next steps: (1) add a focused mixed-script test (ruby + AR parentheses), (2) bisect the post-merge commits to find the change that uses codepoint iteration instead of grapheme clusters, (3) add ICU-based grapheme ops in the pass or disable it permanently.

haruto: I'll start the bisect on the heuristic patch set. dave leave the minimal repro and token-id dumps in /ci/repro/2987654321.

dave: done. Repro script and token diffs uploaded. Pinning staging to post-merge off for now.

eval-bot: nightly jobs scheduled with heuristic disabled for q4 at 03:15 UTC. Artifacts will be posted to /ci/artifacts/2987654321/
